items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Play the piano, yeah. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Savokas? No, not me. The other guys played the piano.

ctx.x: Savokas? No, not me. The other guys played the piano. It always was the piano playing. At that time, musicians, they wasn't getting them, it was about two or three hours, and all the wine he could drink. They had a wine they used to drink, they called a Sweet Lucy. Sweet Lucy, black wine, sweet, sweet, sweet syrup. It was called a Sweet Lucy wine, that's the kind of wine they was drinking at that time.
What kind of band did they have in Savokas? How many pieces?
